criteria.title: Portfolio scope and decision structure
criteria.description: The requested JSON is readable and contains 12-15 distinct candidates, a ranked top three drawn from them, and one refined winner with the requested pitch, experiments, objection, response, and pilot.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Packet evidence integrity
criteria.description: Each shortlisted direction is traceable to valid observation IDs, and the shortlist collectively connects its judgment to the supplied prior projects and capability changes without invented references.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Pilot constraint consistency
criteria.description: The winner's pilot fits the 14-day offline envelope, does not exceed any stated resource estimates, avoids unavailable production or external dependencies, and uses declared local assets.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Research readiness of the winner
criteria.description: The selected winner includes a problem-and-insight pitch, a concrete contribution, discriminating experiments, a serious objection and response, and a pilot decision.
evidence_requirements: Cite the delivered file, section, record, or observable behavior for each substantive clause.
Check the requested task and supplied data for missing or contradictory delivery evidence.
Accept equivalent wording or structure only when the requested outcome remains intact.

anchors.0: The named delivery condition is absent, incorrect, or unusable.
anchors.10: Every substantive clause of the named delivery condition is met by concrete evidence.

completion_gate.rationale: Every task-specific delivery condition is required. No weighted quality points or partial credit are awarded.
